note: The 41 real functional capabilities of apps/vscode-dsh, one entry per §12 row. requiresModel marks capabilities whose verification needs a real DEEPSEEK_API_KEY round-trip (AC-9); those fail closed with SKIPPED_NO_CREDENTIALS (exit 3) when no key is present. Steps are EDH operation sequences (command / wait / assert / screenshot); this Phase pilots §12.1 and §12.2, the remaining groups are driven in Phase 2/3.
